title: Technical Portfolio Lead, Fintech VIT
oneLiner: Owned the technical side of the college fintech committee for a full season.
claim: Built and shipped the committee's scroll-driven 3D vault site - 11 members, 6 portfolios and 3 events behind one scroll journey.

metrics: The site shipped with a scripted camera audit and a motion diagnostic in CI
proof.architecture: The site is one content model rendered three ways: a 3D vault journey for the room, a plain HTML reading copy for search engines and screen readers, and the committee content as machine-readable JSON. The technical portfolio owned the renderer, the content pipeline and the audit scripts.
